> Mini Arcade is a game  based on an ESP32. It has two game options: Roulette and Slot Machine. The game uses a TFT screen . There are buttons to switch between the two games and to play. It fits on a breadboard and is easy to build.

## Design

### 2026-11-01: October 26: Selecting the Project

**7h**

October 26: Selecting the Project

So here we are in Week 4. The theme this week was about displays. We had to work on a project involving a display.

On October 26 I started searching for project ideas and finally decided on a Mini Arcade Box. Initially I was thinking of making a roulette machine, where we could play roulette using buttons and a display.

After finalizing the idea I started thinking about how the project would work and what features I could include.

October 27: Designing and Selecting Components

Today I started working on the design. I made two designs and spent around two hours finalizing the one I liked best.

After finalizing the design I also prepared a list of all the components required for the project.

![Screenshot 2026-11-01 202950](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/54f59c3e7586ef6d3e09ae75bef61ccd93d41fc229a4314fd8bb97153e6773da.jpg)
Time spent: 2 hours.

October 28: Working on the Code

Today I started working on the hardware code.

Since this was a Mini Arcade Box I decided not to make a PCB. Instead I was going to assemble everything on a breadboard.

![1st](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/6b6053c4f3d4305418d6d9ec8eaea9809f1efa5cd9a32a5829f4232d9beef170.jpg)

![2nd](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/2770bbe1dc09ce0a3b0158e0f3fa85685568ff9acbae0c6bdb02b41333d17242.jpg)

![3rd](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/8eedf4315d1a8b8172f85c883cf366c4a01041b0eef6a8d8b417287ba881cab2.jpg)

![4th](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/dc5d5ceeee5eabf806b90b5ba80a52b2e2ffb8e6de4a91da10d05c41ebec4b49.jpg)

### 2026-11-01: October 29: Simulation and Testing

**5h**

October 29: Simulation and Testing

Today I tested the project using the Wokwi simulator. I uploaded the code examined how the project was working and fixed the errors that appeared. I also tested the functionalities to ensure the roulette mode was working as expected. Time spent: 3 hours.

![Screenshot 2026-10-29 211226](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/2c59af06e8fa82df2835bac702ecb21e6946b4c46682bce148333301151a68ab.jpg)

![Screenshot 2026-10-29 212654](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/69780e4f1db6b55476c87b1163c72b20071a3fef78b61e9e8dd9676681f78478.jpg)

![ss](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/d997d7e502c5aa412deddd62990828f07358f27e92763b3d37ca6f1fd8252834.jpg)
October 30: Adding the Slot Machine Mode

Today I decided to add another mode to the Mini Arcade Box: the Slot Machine! So now of having only roulette the arcade box would have two modes that could be switched between. I started writing the code for the slot machine and worked on integrating it with the existing roulette code. This took me around two hours; after finishing the coding I tested the project again. Finally both modes were working properly in the simulation!. That is it! The project is finally complete. Since I was not making a PCB, for the project I did not have to go through the PCB design and routing process. The hardware was planned to be assembled on a breadboard and the simulation was also working perfectly.

![slot](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/3c78c7c254aee8550bfc73277b2e31759dbd2b9fd92a14854d4e59a0ffff469b.jpg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-11-01 at 9.09.53 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/975a9b45edcb27abec199c36efe64e3091b7ef2bab0431e80a54ae4de6ebf10e.jpg)
This took me around two hours, and after completing the coding, I tested the project again.

### 2026-11-01: October 31: Integrating Both Modes and Final Testing

**3h**

October 31: Integrating Both Modes and Final Testing

After finishing the code for both the roulette mode and the slot machine mode I combined both codes into one program. I also made a shared interface for the Mini Arcade Box so that I could move between the two modes.

After putting everything I ran tests on the full code using Wokwi to see if both modes were working correctly and if switching between them was working the way it should.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-11-01 at 9.21.34 PM 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/r1nSTxCFQ2zE35VmMrOpNVe2xLvWebY1/e75e1506f689af48f386375109c42689a9be87bb64700995ece9b6ba13d06fe2.jpg)
